text: יוֹעִילָם. בְּרִית לִזְכּוֹר: זֵכֶר נְקוּבֵי מַטּוֹת. שְׁבוּעוֹת מַטּוֹת. נְדִידוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת. לְאַמְּצָם יִזְכֹּר: נֹשְׂאֵי עֹל מוֹטַת. אִם פָּץ לְהַמְטוֹת. נֶפֶץ חֲדַר הַמִּטּוֹת. לְכִפּוּר יִזְכֹּר: זֵכֶר מְצוּקִים. יְסוֹד מוּצָקִים. מִפְעָלָם לְצַעֲקִים. בְּפוּט חָשׁ לִזְכּוֹר: מִפִּי יוֹנְקִים. אֲשֶׁר בַּסּוּף נֶאֱקִים. מַאֲמַר בְּרִית וְחֻקִּים. דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ יִזְכֹּר: זֵכֶר לִין כְּפָרִים. וְאִמְרֵי שְׁפָרִים. לִמְשַׁלְּמֵי פָרִים. בְּשָׂפָה יִזְכֹּר: לְעֵת בִּקּוּר סְפָרִים. סְתָרִים מְסַפְּרִים. לִשְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים. לְצֶדֶק יִזְכּוֹר: זֵכֶר כְּבוֹד מִשְׁכָּן. מְקוֹם דּוֹד שָׁכַן. כְּרוּבִים בּוֹ שִׁכֵּן. חֶסֶד נְעוּרִים יִזְכֹּר: כִּיּוֹר עִם כַּן. וְנֹעַם קוֹל דּוּכָן. כַּבִּיר בְּיוֹם מוּכָן. לַנְּבוֹנִים יִזְכּוֹר:

Is it נֶאֱקִים or נֹאֲקִים? Is it בַּסּוּף with a dagesh?

text: בִּנְדִיבִים. כִּי הֵם בַּקֶּבֶר. וְלָנֶצַח שִׁמְךָ לְזִכָּרוֹן: כָּל אֵלֶּה סְמָכוּנִי. וְרַחֲמֶיךָ בִּקַּשְׁתִּי. לוּלֵא הֵם תַּמֹּתִי. וְאֵינִי לְזִכָּרוֹן: כִּי הֵם בִּזְרוֹעַ. עָדֶיךָ לֹא בָאוּ. רוֹמְמוּתֶיךָ בְּפִיהֶם. שָׂמוּ לְזִכָּרוֹן: לְיוֹם זֶה נִכְמָס. סֶכֶם הֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹת. תְּחִלָּה לְיָמִים. וְרֹאשׁ לְזִכָּרֹן: לְהִקָּרֵא בוֹ. כְּתַב עֵט וְשָׁמִיר. גָּלוּי וּבָאֵר. וְיָדוּעַ לְזִכָּרוֹן: מָוֶת וְחַיִּים. שָׁלוֹם וּמִלְחָמוֹת. צַחֲצָחוֹת וָשׂוֹבַע. בָּאִים לְזִכָּרוֹן: מַעַלְלֵי גֶבֶר. וּמִסְפַּר צְעָדָיו. נִשְׁכְּחוּ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ. וְלָאֵל לְזִכָּרוֹן: נִסְתְּרָה דַרְכִּי. מִי יוּכַל שִׂיחַ. לַשָּׁוְא נִכְתַּב לִי. חֵטְא לְזִכָּרוֹן: נֶגֶד פְּנֵי גֶבֶר. מַעֲשָׂיו יוֹכִיחוּ. וְיַעֲנֶה בּוֹ כַּחֲשׁוֹ. עֵד לְזִכָּרוֹן: שִׂיחוּ מְזִמּוֹת אֵל. יַחַד כָּל בְּנֵי אִישׁ. עוֹבְרֵי תַּחַת שֵׁבֶט. כַּצֹּאן לְזִכָּרוֹן: סוֹגֵר

text: adherents are faithless and the Lord intends to reject them, may his prayer avail them that on their behalf the covenant may be remembered. He remembers the noble tribes (twelve), the oath of the tribes, the wanderings of the tribes does He recall, to strengthen them. When He says that He will crush those who bear the heavy yoke, then He remembers as an atonement the destruction of the site of the Sanctuary. He remembers the foundation stones (forefathers), who groan in Egyptian slavery. The sucklings who praised the Lord at the Sea of Reeds, the promise of the covenant (the circumcision) and the statutes (of the Torah), His holy word, all these does He remember. The memory of those who live austerely (students of the Torah) and study His beautiful sayings, who with their lips provide a substitute for sacrificial bullocks, He does remember. When the books that announce what is hidden, are examined, He remembers in love the wonderful pair of brothers. He remembers the honour of the sanctuary, the place where He, the Beloved, did dwell, where He allowed the Cherubim to rest, the love of our youth He remembers. The basin on its frame, the delightful voice (of the Levites) on the Temple steps, the Almighty recalls them in favour of the discerning on the appointed day of judgment.

for remembrance. O Lord, in Thee do I trust and not in princes, for they are in the grave and Thy Name is for ever for remembrance. All these supported me but I seek Thy compassion, without it I should have perished and not survived for remembrance. For in spite of their strength, they could not plead for me before Thee, those in whose mouths is Thy greatness have placed it there for remembrance. For this day has been stored the sum of assessments, it is the beginning of days and the first for remembrance. On it there is read out what was engraved with a diamond quill, what was revealed and explained and known in remembrance. Death and life, peace and war, dearth and abundance, appear for remembrance. The acts of man, the number of his steps, though forgotten by men, they are to God for remembrance. “My way is hidden” — who could say that? In vain was a sin inscribed for me for remembrance. In front of man his deeds give evidence, his falsehood bears witness against him for remembrance. Proclaim the plans of the Lord, all men together, pass under the staff like a flock for remembrance. The Lord closes the door on behalf of the flawless during
